name: building_rc_network_3r2c
title: 3R2C building thermal network with weather lookup
summary: Single-zone building thermal network with three thermal capacitances (indoor air, opaque facade, internal masonry walls) coupled through thermal resistances, integrated over one week of July weather read from a lookup table; ventilation is the only heat sink (free-running zone).

authors: TBD (author of the original EES model of the CLIM R06 repetition exercise 2)
origin.course: CLIM (Climatisation, University of Liège), repetition exercise 2

verification.reference: no EES stored solution exists (the model is not in CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip and no file of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models uses this system); the runnable variant building_rc_network_3r2c_coolsolve.eescode was verified (1) against INTERPOLATE of the shipped weather table itself (24 sampled points, 19 differences exactly 0, max 1.07e-14 °C = double round-off) and (2) against an independent RK4 integration of the same equations (h = 15 s): max 0.0081 K on T_in (at tau = 0 s, where CoolSolve reports the initial condition exactly), 0.0002 K on T_c_wall and T_c_in
verification.notes: max_rel_diff is the largest relative deviation of the CoolSolve trajectory from the independent RK4 reference after linear interpolation of the 600 s output rows; it comes from the output-interval interpolation, not from the model (the RK4 reference converges to 9.21e-4 from h = 300 s to h = 15 s). In absolute terms the two trajectories agree to 0.0081 K on T_in and 0.0002 K on both wall temperatures.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/building_rc_network.eescode (source of the import; stays in the CoolSolve repository)
